caseName: Kansas City Southern Railway Co. v. Leinen

opinions.text: November 15, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Arkansas denied.' Mr. S. W. Moore, Mr. James B. McDonough and Mr. A. F. Smith for petitioner. Mr. Fred B. Wheeler for respondent.
